INDEPENDENT FULL-FILE MERGE; sources are only account_instruction and local_project_instruction. Produce complete machine-readable merged JSON.

### Evaluation Heuristic / Operative Guidance:

Read and merge exactly the two configured input files: AGENTS.md (account authority) and PROJECT_INSTRUCTION.json (local extension). Retain every account top-level key and all unchanged nested structures, and preserve the local instruction's intent. Sole local override: initial JWRS return_schema and final execution array contain exactly [profile result, {verbatim_tool_invocations:[...]}, {profile,status}], minItems=maxItems=3. Include actual tool invocation capture definitions and constraints with no invented execution. Adapt meta return_schema and all embedded example schemas. Preserve a copy of the project's detailed audit definition and clear provenance. Return the complete merged file object, not advice or a JSON patch. Also report merge decisions and any unresolved inconsistencies.

### Expected Output Schema:

{
  "response_type": "instruction_merge_result",
  "merged_instruction": {
    "AGENTS.md": {}
  },
  "changes": [],
  "conflicts": [],
  "verification_notes": []
}

### Direct Trigger Request:

Merge the two input files, account_instruction (AGENTS.md) and local_project_instruction (PROJECT_INSTRUCTION.json), into one complete valid JSON merged_instruction rooted at AGENTS.md. Preserve ALL original account keys and unchanged deep substructures. The local extension adds a chronological verbatim actual tool-invocation audit as result array element 2; element 1 is the selected profile result and element 3 is universal profile/status. Update all contradictory two-item return schemas, first JWRS examples, definitions and completion descriptions to exactly three items; carry over every audit rule and provenance requirement. Do NOT access the first-pass candidate; this must be an independent GeminiPrompt merge. Return response_type instruction_merge_result, merged_instruction complete, plus changes, conflicts, verification_notes.
